priorityList: Use Reaver's Glaive as your highest priority whenever it is available and Aldrachi buffs (Rending Strike/Glaive Flurry) are not active.
In the Aldrachi Reaver window (Rending Strike and Glaive Flurry both active), prioritize Death Sweep or Annihilation to consume the buffs.
Cast Vengeful Retreat to trigger Initiative and Inertia buffs, specifically prepped before Eye Beam or Metamorphosis.
Cast Eye Beam on cooldown to enter Demonic form and deal heavy AoE damage, ideally aligned with Inertia.
Use Metamorphosis if Eye Beam is on cooldown or to refresh Demonic, ensuring you don't overwrite an active Rending Strike window.
Cast Essence Break during Metamorphosis when you have enough Fury to immediately follow up with Death Sweep and Annihilation.
Use Death Sweep (or Blade Dance) on cooldown as your primary AoE damage dealer and Fury spender.
Prioritize Annihilation (or Chaos Strike) during the Essence Break debuff window.
Use Immolation Aura on cooldown for Fury generation and to build Ragefire damage.
Cast The Hunt on cooldown, ensuring Reaver's Glaive buffs are not active to avoid munching procs.
Use Fel Rush to trigger the Inertia damage buff when Inertia Trigger is active, especially before Eye Beam.
Cast Annihilation or Chaos Strike as a filler if you are near Fury cap or to bridge gaps between Blade Dance cooldowns.
Use Felblade as a gap closer or to generate Fury when you are below 40 Fury.
Cast Throw Glaive as a filler when everything else is on cooldown, or if you have 2 charges while Blade Dance is unavailable.
Pick up Soul Fragments using off-GCD movement if you are below 40 Fury.
